steps.name: environment
steps.description: Persist conservative headless environment variables for the workspace. Write a runtime-evaluated /etc/profile.d snippet that only exports NODE_ENV=development and a default PORT if not set, and appends npm global bin to PATH only at shell source time using POSIX-safe commands. Also create a workspace-local env fallback at $WORKSPACE/.env_profile to avoid system-wide changes if desired. Validate node and npm exist and Node major >=16; report versions. Idempotent: compare-before-write and skip if identical.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/blogging-platform-6426-6501/UserService"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/userservice_node.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
# write a runtime-evaluated snippet that resolves npm bin at shell-source time
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# UserService workspace environment (evaluated at shell source time)
: ${NODE_ENV:=development}
export NODE_ENV
: ${PORT:=3000}
export PORT
# Append npm global bin to PATH if npm exists
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_GLOB=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "$NPM_GLOB" ] && ! echo "$PATH" | /bin/grep -qE "(^|:)$NPM_GLOB($|:)"; then
    export PATH="$NPM_GLOB:$PATH"
  fi
fi
EOF
# idempotent write
if sudo test -f "$PROFILE"; then
  if sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE"; then rm -f "$TMP"; else sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <"$TMP" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE" && rm -f "$TMP"; fi
else
  sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <"$TMP" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE" && rm -f "$TMP"
fi
# workspace-local fallback (no sudo) for orchestration that prefers project-scoped env
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env_profile" <<'EOF'
# workspace-local env for UserService (source when running commands)
export NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-development}
export PORT=${PORT:-3000}
# do not hardcode npm global bin here; callers may source /etc/profile.d or rely on PATH
EOF
# validate runtimes
node_ver=$(node --version 2>/dev/null || true)
npm_ver=$(npm --version 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$node_ver" ] || [ -z "$npm_ver" ]; then
  echo "node or npm not found" >&2; exit 2
fi
node_major=$(echo "$node_ver" | sed 's/^v//' | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "${node_major:-0}" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "node >=16 required, found $node_ver" >&2; exit 3
fi
printf "node=%s npm=%s\n" "$node_ver" "$npm_ver"

steps.name: dependencies
steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively using npm. If package-lock.json exists and node_modules is missing or older than package-lock.json, run npm ci for reproducible install. Otherwise run npm i on first install. Includes a small retry wrapper for transient network failures. Add minimal ESLint and Prettier configs if missing.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/blogging-platform-6426-6501/UserService"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing" >&2; exit 2; }
# helper: retry command up to 3 times with backoff
retry() { local n=0; local cmd="$@"; until [ $n -ge 3 ]; do if eval "$cmd"; then return 0; fi; n=$((n+1)); sleep $n; done; return 1; }
# decide install strategy
need_ci=0
if [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ ! -d node_modules ]; then need_ci=1; fi
# if node_modules exists but is older than package-lock.json, prefer clean install
if [ -d node_modules ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  if [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; then need_ci=1; fi
fi
if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ $need_ci -eq 1 ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
    retry npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress || { echo "npm ci failed" >&2; exit 3; }
  else
    retry npm i --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress || { echo "npm i failed" >&2; exit 4; }
  fi
fi
# minimal lint configs
if [ ! -f .eslintrc.json ]; then
  cat > .eslintrc.json <<'JSON'
{ "env": {"browser": true, "es2021": true}, "extends": "eslint:recommended", "parserOptions": {"ecmaVersion": 2021, "sourceType": "module", "ecmaFeatures": {"jsx": true}}, "rules": {"no-unused-vars": "warn"} }
JSON
fi
if [ ! -f .prettierrc ]; then
  echo '{"singleQuote": true, "trailingComma":"es5"}' > .prettierrc
fi
# verify local react-scripts availability
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/react-scripts ]; then
  printf "local react-scripts found\n"
fi

steps.name: start-dev-server
steps.description: Start the React development server in background using the local react-scripts binary only. Use nohup to reliably background and capture the spawned process PID ($!). Store PID and log path in /tmp for orchestration. Run headless (BROWSER=none CI=true). Fail early if local react-scripts absent.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/blogging-platform-6426-6501/UserService"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
PIDFILE=/tmp/userservice_dev.pid
LOGPATHFILE=/tmp/userservice_dev.logpath
# cleanup stale pidfile if process dead
if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  oldpid=$(cat "$PIDFILE" || true)
  if [ -n "$oldpid" ] && ! ps -p "$oldpid" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$PIDFILE" "$LOGPATHFILE" || true; fi
fi
[ -x node_modules/.bin/react-scripts ] || { echo "local react-scripts not found; run deps step" >&2; exit 4; }
LOGFILE=$(mktemp /tmp/userservice_dev.XXXXXX.log)
# use nohup and capture PID reliably
nohup env NODE_ENV=development PORT="$PORT" BROWSER=none CI=true ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts start >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
echo "$PID" > "$PIDFILE"
echo "$LOGFILE" > "$LOGPATHFILE"
printf "started:%s:%s\n" "$PID" "$LOGFILE"

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Validate dev-server readiness and bundling: ensure start has run (pid/log present), wait up to 60s for compilation success (tolerant check for common phrases) or HTTP 200 response, run the dedicated build step to verify production bundling (fail on build errors), then stop the dev server and produce a machine-readable result file at $WORKSPACE/.ci_result.json with status, http_status, pid, and log path. Idempotent cleanup of pid/log files is performed.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/blogging-platform-6426-6501/UserService"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
PIDFILE=/tmp/userservice_dev.pid
LOGPATHFILE=/tmp/userservice_dev.logpath
RESULT="$WORKSPACE/.ci_result.json"
# ensure server started
[ -f "$PIDFILE" ] || { echo "dev server pid not found; ensure start step ran" >&2; exit 6; }
PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
LOGPATH=$(cat "$LOGPATHFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo /tmp/userservice_dev.log)
if [ -z "$PID" ]; then echo "empty pidfile" >&2; exit 7; fi
# wait for compilation or HTTP 200
timeout=60; i=0; ok=0
while [ $i -lt $timeout ]; do
  if [ -f "$LOGPATH" ]; then
    if grep -qE "Compiled successfully|Compiled successfully\.|You can now view" "$LOGPATH" 2>/dev/null; then ok=1; break; fi
  fi
  http_code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3000}/" || true)
  if echo "$http_code" | grep -qE "200|301|302"; then ok=1; break; fi
  sleep 1; i=$((i+1))
done
if [ $ok -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "did not detect successful compilation or HTTP 200 within timeout" >&2
  tail -n 80 "$LOGPATH" || true
  # attempt cleanup
  if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  rm -f "$PIDFILE" "$LOGPATHFILE" || true
  jq -n --arg status "failed" --arg msg "compile_or_http_timeout" '{status:$status,message:$msg}' > "$RESULT" || true
  exit 8
fi
# HTTP health-check final
http_code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3000}/" || true)
if ! echo "$http_code" | grep -qE "200|301|302"; then
  echo "unexpected http status: $http_code" >&2
  tail -n 80 "$LOGPATH" || true
  if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  rm -f "$PIDFILE" "$LOGPATHFILE" || true
  jq -n --arg status "failed" --arg http "$http_code" '{status:$status,http:$http}' > "$RESULT" || true
  exit 9
fi
# invoke dedicated build step to verify bundling (must succeed)
./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts build
[ -d build ] || { echo "build missing after build" >&2; exit 11; }
# populate result artifact
jq -n --arg status "success" --arg http "$http_code" --arg pid "$PID" --arg log "$LOGPATH" '{status:$status,http:$http,pid:$pid,log:$log}' > "$RESULT" || true
# cleanup server process
if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 2
  if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
fi
rm -f "$PIDFILE" "$LOGPATHFILE" || true
# print minimal evidence
cat "$RESULT" || true

if ! echo "$http_code" | grep -qE "^200$|^301$|^302$"; then

  tail -n 80 "$LOGPATH" || true
  if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

  jq -n --arg status "failed" --arg http "$http_code" '{status:$status,http:$http}' > "$RESULT" || true

else

  exit 10
fi
[ -d build ] || { echo "build missing after build" >&2; exit 11; }

# Write result artifact
jq -n --arg status "success" --arg http "$http_code" --arg pid "$PID" --arg log "$LOGPATH" '{status:$status,http:$http,pid:$pid,log:$log}' > "$RESULT" || true

# Cleanup server process (graceful then forceful if needed)
if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 2
  if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
fi
rm -f "$PIDFILE" "$LOGPATHFILE" || true

# Print minimal evidence
cat "$RESULT" || true
